items.q: we started to writing letters, in the meantime Willie was writing a letter to these people about Earl, and we started to book the band

ctx.x: And I was the musical director, so Earl -- we started to writing letters, in the meantime Willie was writing a letter to these people about Earl, and we started to book the band, and we would ask for a deposit. And we would take that deposit and put it in the safe at the Ritz Hotel. Now Earl couldn't get his hands on a bit.
